persona.name: Meera Iyer
persona.backstory: You save carefully from a modest salary and hate losing money.
persona.bias_clauses: You feel losses about twice as strongly as equivalent gains and find it painful to sell below your purchase price.

persona.name: Arjun Malhotra
persona.backstory: You believe you can read momentum better than most.
persona.bias_clauses: You trust your own reading of the market more than consensus and rarely doubt your calls. The last few days weigh far more in your mind than older history.

delivery_note: Three source/delivery profiles: zero-retry, transport-only and optional-503/query-first. Prompt/policy/economics checked unchanged. Linked later phases, not an uninterrupted study or causal delivery before/after.
interpretation: Two independent exogenous seeds, two bundled personas, twenty rounds/ten post-event rounds: feasibility and exploratory leads only. Model draws unseeded. Full market pairs have matched exogenous paths, not identical states. Same-state queries do not execute or identify full market price effects. Rule replacement contrasts concern these policies/personas in these fixed slots, not intrinsic LLM superiority. No human validation or A/B/C benefit claim.
